subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this exact `iterationBudget` config shape and `supportsIterationBudget`/`onBeforeToolCallingRound` harness contract as the permanent public API?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and proven, but its naming, defaults, parent/subagent distinction, forced-summary behavior, and unsupported-harness failure mode establish long-lived user and plugin contracts that cannot be selected safely through code review alone.

options.title: Adopt the proposed contract
options.body: Keep the opt-in defaults, parent/subagent limits, forced summary, and fail-closed harness capability as implemented, then refresh and land the PR.

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Ship a smaller single-limit or core-only contract and defer subagent, summary, or plugin-capability semantics.

options.title: Decline new config surface
options.body: Continue relying on timeouts, retry limits, and reactive loop detection without a separate hard round budget.

recommendation.title: Adopt the proposed contract
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in defaults, parent/subagent limits, forced summary, and fail-closed harness capability as implemented, then refresh and land the PR.

likelyOwner.reason: She is assigned to this PR and authored the current-head integration across both affected runtime boundaries.
